sources.title: NGSS MS-LS3-2: Develop and use a model to describe why asexual reproduction results in offspring with identical genetic information and sexual reproduction results in offspring with genetic variation
OpenStax Biology 2e, 12.1 Mendel's Experiments and the Laws of Probability

note.text: A Punnett square predicts the offspring of two parents. Here, two pea plants with violet flowers.

steps.title: Four boxes
steps.instruction: Draw the lines that divide it into four boxes.

note.text: Each parent has two copies of the flower-color gene, called alleles. Each passes one on, by chance.

steps.title: Fill it in
steps.instruction: Combine the letter above with the letter at the side for each box.

mistakes.Vv: This box gets v from the top and v from the side: vv.

steps.title: Dominant
steps.question: A plant is Vv. What color are its flowers?

options.feedback: Yes. One dominant allele is enough to show the trait. The white allele is hidden.
White shows only with two recessive alleles, vv.
In peas, V is fully dominant. Vv flowers are violet.
For pea flower color, V is fully dominant, so Vv is violet.

steps.title: Predict
steps.question: What is the chance that an offspring has white flowers?

options.feedback: Right. Only the vv box gives white flowers. The other three give violet: about 3 violet to 1 white.
Both parents carry a hidden v. One box in four is vv: white.
Two boxes are Vv, but those are violet. Only vv, one box in four, is white.
Three of the four boxes have at least one V, so they're violet.

steps.title: Variation
steps.question: Why can two violet parents have a white-flowered offspring?

options.text: Each parent passes on one allele, and both can pass on their hidden v
options.feedback: Yes. Sexual reproduction mixes alleles from two parents, so offspring can differ from both.

options.text: The flower changed color as it grew
options.feedback: The color comes from the alleles it inherited: vv gives white.
It's expected. Mixing alleles from two parents creates variation.
White is recessive. It shows when an offspring gets v from both parents.
